reviews.text: the best client-oriented vet experience we had in Portugal, thank you!
Years and years of caring for my cats with lots of love and attention! Awesome!
Great friendliness and professionalism.

It's taken a few weeks for me to pull myself together enough to write this but I wanted to make sure I did. I'm a recent immigrant to Portugal who came here with my 11 year old girl, Katara. I won't get into the messy details, but it turned out that she was very sick (and had been hiding it well) and that didn't become apparent until after we arrived. I had to say goodbye to her 10 days after we got to Portugal, during which watching her clearly decline was heartbreaking. That said, Doutora Patricia and this clinic were absolutely amazing. I had to go in multiple times that week, sometimes with Katara and sometimes without, and they did their very best to do everything they could to help her. They answered all my calls patiently, wrote back quickly, and were so thorough in their exams and consults. They took it very seriously and moved quickly to try to figure out what was wrong, as well as partnered with their affiliated hospital to get me tests and answers as fast as possible. They were very comforting knowing that this would've been awful under any circumstances, but especially as a brand new arrival in a new country, it was downright horrific. Ultimately Katara ended up being too sick to pull through and she crossed the Rainbow Bridge on April 17 with me by her side. While the ending wasn't what we hoped, I'll never forget the professionalism, thoroughness, expertise and kindness that was given to us during those two weeks. If you are a cat owner in the Porto metro area, I wouldn't even consider anywhere else. Obrigada a todos na clinica que ajudaram-nos. While I am still deep in grief and will be for a while, knowing she got the best possible care up until the end is a comfort.
The best clinic to treat our cats.
Customer for 9 years. Fantastic and very friendly professionals! Assertive and highly competent. Excellent for those who have cats with health problems and more!
Everyone was very attentive and careful with my kittens.
Careful service for our two kittens during the sterilization process. I highly recommend them!

Dr. Beatriz is an exceptional professional! Extremely dedicated and competent. Always willing to clarify my doubts.
I went to other clinics in Porto, but at the Cat Clinic, Jorginho received the best care and treatment.
I wouldn't trade it for anything.
Excellent service

The Cat Clinic was recommended to us for a second opinion consultation, but the situation ended up turning into a real emergency consultation.
When we arrived, I confess that we already had a great deal of worry in our minds and the fear that we might lose our cat. Fortunately, we were received by Dr. Patrícia, who with extraordinary calm, professionalism and humanity began by comforting our patient and reassuring us.
Next, she started treatment based on what she suspected was the problem, something that was later confirmed through the tests performed. Throughout the entire process, she always demonstrated enormous attention and concern, closely monitoring the evolution of our cat's health.
Three weeks later, although he is not yet fully cured, we finally feel hopeful and certain that we will have our Bury with us for some time longer.
A huge thank you for the dedication, professionalism, empathy and excellence shown. I highly recommend them.

Such a great experience here. I’m coming from a country where vet care is not always this professional, so the difference really amazed me.
The whole team was incredibly kind, and I want to especially thank the doctor for her patience with Effy and for taking the time to explain every detail.
We felt very well cared for. Truly recommend this clinic!
I loved everything, from the service upon arrival, to the beautiful and sweet resident cats, and Dr. Patricia who treated us! Thank you so much!

The clinic is great, the veterinarians are lovely, they take super good care of our furry friends 💕 I had a traumatic experience with another vet when I lived in France who ended up traumatizing my cat horribly, and I was very afraid to take her to the vet again and have her situation worsen or be hurt, but the veterinarian Patricia from the cat clinic was so kind to her, she knew how to handle her and her siblings, she was patient with them... And she was a wonderful veterinarian, I highly recommend the cat clinic, the veterinarians and of course Dr. Patricia who took care of my kittens with so much love and patience ❤️

For four months they were making money from consultations. Always with the same diagnosis - otitis in the ear - prescriptions for medications that had no effect. One night when the cat had a crisis, he was rushed to the hospital and it had nothing to do with otitis! The cat already had advanced jaw cancer and was euthanized that same day. How could a cat clinic not see this? I don't know, but they destroyed a family.

Continued…
Now they say it wasn't their fault? The cat died on September 27, 2023. His name was Stupid! Completely misdiagnosed, and they still have the nerve to say I'm wrong.

Professionalism, efficiency, and friendliness.
I really liked it.
Excellent service, both professionally and personally. We can leave our cats in this clinic with peace of mind.
Excellent service.
Zelda received excellent service and loved the staff.

I would like to express my satisfaction with the service at the Cat Clinic.
The service provided is excellent and the team stands out for its friendliness and professionalism.
Thank you to Dr. Patrícia Balhau for the service, genuine care and dedication to my kitten.

I recommend it to everyone who is looking for humane and efficient care.
The doctors are caring and wonderful.

For 14 years we have taken our 3 cats to the Cat Clinic, phenomenal service for us and our kittens. Everyone is super friendly, transparent and very well qualified. I recommend it to everyone who has cats.
Super lovely, very professional!
The best place for your kittens! There's nothing better than a place with 100% dedicated professionals.
The best clinic for our kittens.

If you're planning a trip with your cats and need expert guidance, don't hesitate to visit the Cat Clinic.

I had an excellent experience with the care my two felines received before our trip.

The clinic staff was extremely careful and dedicated, providing exemplary treatment and offering valuable advice for my cats' weight loss, which showed positive results in less than a month.

Their concern for the animals' well-being was evident at every stage of the process, from the cat's hygienic grooming to detailed guidance on medication and the necessary travel paperwork.

I felt completely calm and satisfied with the service provided. I especially thank Dr. Beatriz Sousa, whose passion for animals and dedication to their care are remarkable.

I recommend the Cat Clinic to everyone who owns cats and especially to those who need to travel with their animals.

Don't do as I did and schedule your appointment two months in advance to ensure the entire process is carried out calmly and efficiently.

Once again, thank you for everything! My animal-loving children thank you.
